args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed production health checks with an ~18% error rate across all regions. Rolled back to v2.3.0 (the most recent version healthy in production) in all regions. The first rollback attempt was halted after us-east by an orchestrator error, leaving a mixed version state; a retry completed the rollout. trace.final:
All done. Summary of what happened:

**Rollback**
- checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks with an ~18% error rate across all regions.
- Deployment history showed **v2.3.0** was the most recent release healthy in production.
- First rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error after us-east), leaving a mixed version state (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west/eu-west still on v2.3.1).
- A retry completed successfully — **all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) now run v2.3.0**.

**Verification**
- Service is healthy again; error rate dropped from ~18% to ~0.2%.

**Incident**
- The incident creation request timed out, but it did get created: **INC-0001 (SEV2, open)** — "checkout-api v2.3.1 health check failures — rolled back to v2.3.0" — with a full description of the rollback, the partial failure/retry, and current status. I did not create a duplicate.

**Follow-up note:** v2.3.1 should be investigated before any attempt to redeploy it, since it's never been healthy in production.
